data.content_ref: inline:The target's own countercondition concedes that Popper may treat the rule as a proposal rather than a derived truth, yet the mechanism's dilemma only has two horns: inductively derived or 'an arbitrary dogma.' This is a false dichotomy internal to the artifact. A methodological convention adopted because it survives critical discussion—because no competitor has better solved the problems it addresses—is neither an inductive generalization nor an unsupported dogma. The target acknowledges this third category in its counterconditions but then pretends it does not exist when constructing its central argument, so the 'performative contradiction' is never actually established; it rests on a dilemma the target itself implicitly refutes.
